description: Sustained 90 s hold at the champion_stand_ground_v1 stand pose. Robot ON THE GROUND (unsupported), operator watching, hands ready. Purpose: measure servo CURRENT, TEMPERATURE and TILT DRIFT during a stand held for tens of seconds -- the champion stand has only ever been proved for 15 s, and thermal sag under continuous load is the classic failure mode of cheap STS3215 legs. No new motion: seg 1 replays the champion_stand_ground_v1 trajectory, resampled to 10 Hz (150 ticks, 15 s) to reach the stand; seg 2 commands that trajectory's final 18-joint pose as a constant for 90 s (900 ticks); seg 3 replays the same trajectory time-reversed (150 ticks, 15 s) back to bench zero, then the runner limps. 120 s total at 10 Hz. Loaded current budget 2.0 A; requires force=true. RATE-REDUCTION REPLICA of champion_stand_ground_hold90_v1: identical pose and structure, command rate dropped 25 Hz -> 10 Hz to isolate bus bandwidth / timing headroom at 18 joints as the cause of the tracking trips and bus write timeouts seen in the 25 Hz runs. Seg 1/3 are that protocol's 375-tick trajectory linearly resampled to 150 ticks over the same 15 s, same start and final pose.
name: champion_stand_ground_hold90_10hz_v1
